title: init() enables the client without TWILIO_STATUS_CALLBACK_BASE_URL, contradicting the four-required-keys spec
evidence:
case sid, token, alpha_sender {
    Some(sid), Some(token), Some(alpha_sender) ->
      Enabled(TwilioConfig(
        account_sid: sid,
        auth_token: token,
        alpha_sender:,
        status_callback_base_url: base_url |> option.unwrap(""),
      ))
    _, _, _ -> {
--- spec T1.2 (same diff) ---
  - [x] T1.2 `pub fn init() -> Twilio` — reads `TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID` / `TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN` / `TWILIO_ALPHA_SENDER` / `TWILIO_STATUS_CALLBACK_BASE_URL` via `envoy`; returns `Disabled` when any required key is absent
detail: T1.2 lists four env vars and disables on any absent, but init() only checks three. With base_url unset the client stays Enabled and sends omit StatusCallback, breaking the AC1 callback contract.
recommended_fix: Require TWILIO_STATUS_CALLBACK_BASE_URL in init() (return Disabled when absent) to match T1.2, or amend the spec to mark it optional.

title: do_send logs HTTP/connection failures locally but not parse/build failures
detail: HTTP-status and connection failures call both capture_failure and wisp.log_error, but the 2xx-but-unparseable and request-build failures only capture to Sentry with no local log_error. Inconsistent error visibility.
recommended_fix: Add wisp.log_error to the decode-failure and build-failure branches, or route every failure through one capture+log helper.
